design_context.topology: R1 connects IN to OUT; C1 connects OUT to ground.
design_context.simulation_status: The checked-in netlist remains an ideal R/C example. This BOM is a source-linked physical-part mapping, not a claim that the existing simulation uses vendor models or that a PCB exists.

resistor_worst_case_estimate.calculation: 5.5 V squared divided by (1000 ohm times (1 - 0.01))
resistor_worst_case_estimate.result: pass for the stated <=70 C ambient assumption in a tolerance-only calculation; excludes TCR and self-heating, so it is not a complete continuous worst-case bound

capacitor_dc_voltage.result: pass for the stated supply range; effective capacitance under DC bias and temperature is not represented by the ideal C primitive

derating_assessment.temperature_scope: The 30.56 mW resistor estimate uses initial tolerance and excludes TCR and self-heating. An illustrative negative 100 ppm/C TCR adjustment from 25 C to 70 C gives 30.69 mW only if the resistor element stays at ambient; actual element temperature is unknown. Resistor power rating is specified at 70 C; use above 70 C requires the Yageo series derating curve and a refreshed power check. Capacitor operating range is -55 C to +125 C, but the checked-in operating-case sweep does not vary temperature.

mapping_review.manufacturer_data_source: YAGEO product specification pages linked on each selected part
mapping_review.note: The standard footprint files and passive pad numbering were checked; this is library/part mapping evidence, not a claim that a KiCad board has passed P5 ERC/DRC or parity.

sourcing.query_mode: Exact manufacturer part number, one candidate, 0603 footprint
sourcing.llm: Ollama gemma4 (local); used to interpret the query, not to establish datasheet ratings
sourcing.timestamp_note: snapshot_time_utc is the local UTC capture time for the two MCP requests; the supplier responses do not carry timestamps. Refreshed on 2026-11-08; exact MPNs were returned by Traces 3.4.2 using local Ollama gemma4.
sourcing.credentials: No JLCPCB/LCSC API credential was configured or required for this test
sourcing.lead_time_note: Not returned by the tested source_component response; recheck with the supplier before ordering
sourcing.substitution_policy: No alternatives are pre-approved. Any substituted manufacturer part number requires a new original-datasheet review, package/pad check, supplier snapshot, operating-limit and derating review, model-pin review, and re-run of applicable verification cases.

items.role: Series resistor from IN to OUT

selected_part.price_basis: Unit price returned by Traces; price break and minimum order quantity were not included in that response. Treat as a sourcing snapshot, not a purchase quote.

footprint_and_pin_map.note: The resistor is non-polarized; its two terminals are electrically interchangeable. KiCad standard-library pad numbering, geometry and file hash were checked against the pinned KiCad 10.0.8 image recorded in mapping_review.

simulation_model_mapping.limitation: The current example uses the ideal resistance parameter; it does not load a Yageo SPICE model or simulate TCR, parasitics, self-heating, or the selected part's power curve.

selected_part.price_basis: Unit price returned by Traces; price break and minimum order quantity were not included in that response. Treat as a sourcing snapshot, not a purchase quote.

footprint_and_pin_map.note: The capacitor is non-polarized. KiCad standard-library pad numbering, geometry and file hash were checked against the pinned KiCad 10.0.8 image recorded in mapping_review.
